preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 58.
The lengths of the blue and red arc lists must be equal to n - 1.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i] <= n and 1 <= r[i] <= n for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: All blue and red arc endpoints must be within the valid vertex range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not reachable else str(first_time)
postconditions.description: If the state is unreachable, output -1; otherwise, output the first time the state appears.

postconditions.expression: any(query in visited_states for query in queries)
postconditions.description: Each query state must be checked against previously visited states to determine reachability.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= first_time <= 10**18 for first_time in first_times)
postconditions.description: The first time each state appears must be a non-negative integer within a reasonable range.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= v < n for v, s in queries)
invariants.description: The vertex v in each query must be less than n.

invariants.expression: all(len(s) == n - 1 and set(s) <= {'R', 'B'} for v, s in queries)
invariants.description: Each query string s must have length n - 1 and consist only of 'R' and 'B'.
